The Program Factory

We manufacture insurance programs.

We do not just sell insurance. We engineer and build the businesses that write it, one niche program at a time.

How the line works
From idea to profitable program, engineered from the underwriter outward.
+
Every program starts with a custom request and a proven underwriter, not a product we are trying to sell. From there it runs the line: recruit the team, design the program around their appetite, bring in the capital, underwrite, actuarial, match to capacity, wire up the technology, launch, and often, sell. Each program is branded on its own and built clean, so it can stand alone, or be sold.
TeleMac, our AI
Proprietary technology we build in-house.
+
TeleMac is our own AI and underwriting technology, built to analyze, price, and place risk faster than a traditional shop can, and to run every program with the reporting and data visibility that institutional capacity partners require. It is the engine underneath the factory.
Built to order
Tell us the class you want written. We go build it.
+
Rather than pushing products, we source what capacity partners actually want. Name a class, and we go find the underwriter who has mastered it, the book that proves the market, and the distribution that scales it, then wrap it in the right paper and platform. The weirder the risk, the better.
Let's build together

If you can help us, invest in us, or build with us, let's talk.

We are building fast, and we are serious. We have a platform, a team, and momentum, and we are looking for partners. Specialty insurance is one of the best businesses to be in, and if you want in, you talk to me.
